intro.features_description: StingStream works with a few optional services. You will find them in Settings:
intro.jellyseerr_feature_description: Connect to your Seerr instance and request movies directly in the app.
intro.downloads_feature_description: Download movies and series to watch offline.

intro.centralised_settings_plugin_description: Settings can be managed centrally on your server. Every device syncs automatically.
intro.crash_reports_description: StingStream sends anonymous crash and error reports to the developers when this is turned on. No account data or server addresses are included. You can turn this off here or anytime in settings.

transfers.remove_confirm_message: The download is removed from the queue. Files already on disk are kept.
transfers.remove_confirm_message_files: The download and any files it has written are removed. This cannot be undone.

server_settings.external_clients_empty_detail: StingStream downloads through its own two engines. Add one here if you already run a client somewhere else.
server_settings.external_clients_explainer: A client running somewhere else — another machine you run, an existing qBittorrent or SABnzbd. StingStream downloads through it alongside the engines above, at a lower priority, so its own engines stay the default.
server_settings.external_clients_password_placeholder: Password, or an API key for SABnzbd
server_settings.external_clients_remove_confirm_message: StingStream stops downloading through it. Downloads already running in it are not touched.
server_settings.indexers_empty_detail: Add a Torznab indexer above — StingStream searches it for films and for series.
server_settings.indexers_name_and_url_required: Name and Torznab base URL are required
server_settings.indexers_remove_confirm_message: "{{name}}" is removed from StingStream's settings. Searches already set up against it are not undone — sync only ever adds and updates.
server_settings.indexers_test_explainer: "Test" tries the indexer with exactly the resource a save would store, once for films and once for series. Each sends a different category list, so an endpoint carrying films but no television passes one and fails the other.
server_settings.notifications_webhook_group_title: StingStream's own webhook (drives the federated import path)
server_settings.quality_profiles_default_name_detail: Everything added without a profile of its own is filed under this one.
server_settings.quality_profiles_delete_confirm_message: The profile is removed for films and series alike. It is refused while any title is still using it.
server_settings.quality_profiles_empty_detail: There are none yet, which normally means StingStream has not finished starting. Press "New" to add one.
server_settings.quality_profiles_no_vocabulary: StingStream could not list the qualities it can fetch.
server_settings.quality_profiles_pick_qualities_first: Pick some qualities first — the cutoff has to be one of them.
server_settings.quality_profiles_rename_hint: The name is the profile's identity, so it cannot be renamed here — a rename that took for films and failed for series would leave two half-profiles. Add the new one and delete this.
server_settings.quality_profiles_showing_every_detail: Every quality StingStream knows. Anything films or series cannot fetch is ignored, and you are told which when you save.
server_settings.quality_profiles_showing_shared_detail: The qualities that work for films and series alike — the safe set for a profile that governs both.
server_settings.quality_presets_detail: Each one sets which formats this server will fetch, and when to stop looking for a better copy. You can adjust it afterwards.
server_settings.quality_presets_unavailable: This server cannot fetch anything in that range.
server_settings.quality_preset_everyday_detail: 1080p, falling back to 720p. What most things are released at, and quick to fetch.
server_settings.quality_preset_high_detail: 1080p including untouched disc rips. Much larger files.
server_settings.quality_preset_uhd_detail: 4K where it exists, 1080p where it does not. Needs the bandwidth and a screen to match.
server_settings.quality_preset_anything_detail: Take whatever is available, at any size.
server_settings.quality_profiles_individual_detail: Or pick formats one at a time.
server_settings.quality_profiles_upgrade_title: Upgrade an existing file when a better release appears
server_settings.torrent_dht_detail: Off by default. A trackerless magnet is refused up front rather than stalling while off.
server_settings.torrent_listen_port_detail: 0 asks the OS for an ephemeral port

downloading.title: Downloading
downloading.detail: Whether this server goes and gets things it does not have yet.
downloading.series_detail: Search for and fetch series, episode by episode.
downloading.usenet_detail: Fetch over usenet as well as over BitTorrent.
downloading.turned_on: Turned on. It takes a few seconds to start.
downloading.unmanaged_title: This server does not manage downloading.
downloading.unmanaged_detail: It was started on its own rather than by StingStream, so there is nothing here to switch.

server_status.mesh_unavailable_detail: This server hasn't joined a group yet, or hasn't found any other members.
server_status.version_unknown_hint: A dash means that component hasn't reported a version yet.

invites.landing_invited_by: {{name}} invited you. Create an account to start watching.
invites.landing_invited: Create an account to start watching.
invites.landing_libraries: You will be able to watch
invites.landing_administrator_body: Every library, and the run of the server
invites.already_signed_in_body: You are signed in as {{name}} on {{server}}. This invite would create a second account — sign out first if that is what you want.
invites.already_signed_in_spent: You are signed in as {{name}}, so there is nothing to do here — {{reason}}
invites.error_no_code: This link is missing its invite code. Ask whoever sent it to send the whole link — some chat apps cut off the last part.
invites.error_unknown: This invite link is not valid. Ask whoever sent it to send it again, in full.
invites.error_spent: This invite can no longer be used. Ask whoever sent it for a new one.
invites.error_invalid: That name or password cannot be used.
invites.error_unreachable: The server did not answer. Check your connection and try again.
invites.new_description: They open the link and choose a password. It works until you delete it.
invites.role_viewer_hint: They can watch what you pick and ask for more. They cannot change the server.
invites.role_administrator_hint: They can do everything you can: add and remove people, change settings, and link other servers.
invites.libraries_hint: Pick at least one. They will see these and nothing else.
invites.libraries_none: This server has no libraries yet.
invites.minted_link: Send this link to the person you are inviting.
invites.minted_no_link: This server has no address anybody could open, so there is no link. Send them this code — they can enter it in the StingStream app.
invites.minted_administrator_body: Whoever opens it can change this server and everyone on it. Send it only to someone you would hand the server to, and delete it if it goes astray.
invites.lan_only_title: This link works on your home network
invites.lan_only_body: It points at this machine’s address on your network, so it will open for anyone in the house and nowhere else. Give your server a domain and the same invites work from anywhere.
invites.link_gone: That invite has already been used, so there is no link left to show.
invites.copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.detail: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or security key instead of a password. Your password still works.
passkeys.empty_detail: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or security key instead of typing a password. It works on {{domain}}, and your password still works everywhere.
passkeys.row_other_domain: Made for {{domain}} — it will not work at this server's current address.
passkeys.error_unavailable: Passkeys are not available on this server.
passkeys.error_register: That passkey could not be added.
passkeys.error_remove: That passkey could not be removed.
passkeys.error_sign_in: That passkey could not be used to sign in.

users.title: Users
users.empty_detail: Invite someone and they get an account on this server, seeing only the libraries you pick.
users.administrator_on_hint: They can change this server and everyone on it.
users.administrator_off_hint: They can watch what you have shared, and nothing else.
users.administrator_locked_self: You cannot remove your own administrator access.
users.administrator_locked_owner: This account set up the server. It is always an administrator, and that cannot be moved to anybody else.
users.administrator_locked_last: This is the only administrator. Make somebody else one first.
users.reset_hint: Set a new password and pass it on yourself — they are not told.
users.delete_confirm_detail: Their account, their sessions and their playlists go with them, and there is no undo. Disabling keeps the account and locks them out instead.
users.libraries_administrator: Administrators can see every library, whatever is ticked here.
users.dialog_description: Changes here take effect straight away.
users.libraries_hint: They see the ones you tick and nothing else. Ticking all of them means everything, including libraries you add later.
users.disable_locked: Administrators cannot be disabled, and you cannot lock yourself out.
users.linked_remove_confirm_detail: They sign in with a credential from {{server}}, so unlinking closes the only door. Their account, and everything they have watched, stays.

identity.own_server_title: Sign in with your own server
identity.own_server_detail: You will sign in there, not here.
identity.own_server_not_found: Nothing answered at that address. Check it and try again.
identity.own_server_failed: That did not work. Try again.
identity.join_own_server_action: Sign in with my own server
identity.authorize_incomplete: That link is incomplete. Start again from the other server.
identity.authorize_nowhere_to_return: That link did not say where to send you back. Start again from the other server.
identity.authorize_no_node: This page is not being served by a StingStream server, so it cannot complete the sign-in.
identity.authorize_failed: This server could not sign you in to the other one. Try again.

domains.setup_detail: Cloudflare can point a domain here for you: no port forwarding, and it works behind carrier-grade NAT.
domains.setup_dialog_intro: This server will create the tunnel, add the DNS record and save the address.
domains.setup_hostname_hint: The address people will use. Its domain must be on your Cloudflare account.
domains.setup_hostname_invalid: That is not a hostname. Try something like media.example.com.
domains.setup_token_hint: Needs Cloudflare Tunnel: Edit and DNS: Edit. Used once and not stored.
domains.tunnel_disconnect_message: This server stops being reachable from outside your network, and links you have sent stop working. The tunnel and its DNS record stay in your Cloudflare account.
domains.manual_step1_title: Give this machine a fixed address on your network
domains.manual_step1_body: In your router, reserve {{lan}} for it. Without this the next step points at the wrong machine after a reboot.
domains.manual_step2_body: Forward TCP port 443 to port {{port}} on this machine. If the address your router calls external starts with 10., 172.16-31 or 100.64-127, stop here: you are behind carrier-grade NAT and no forwarding will work. Use Cloudflare instead.
domains.manual_step3_body: Add an A record for your domain pointing at the external address your router shows. Home addresses change, so use dynamic DNS unless yours is fixed.
domains.manual_step4_body: Put cert.pem and key.pem from certbot, acme.sh or your router in {{tls}}. Without one a browser will not trust the domain and cannot sign anybody in. Renewals are picked up automatically.
domains.manual_proxy: Already running Caddy, nginx or your own tunnel? Skip all of this — it handles HTTPS. Just type the address above.
domains.manual_done: Then type the domain in the box above and save.
domains.manual_tls_folder: the tls folder in this server's data directory
